verdict.rationale: Relay says it categorizes expenses in real time and syncs transactions automatically to QuickBooks Online and Xero. That is adjacent to GL coding, but the evidence never says the categorization is AI-driven, that it maps to GL accounts, or that it works across multiple entities to speed up close. Missing for 10: explicit AI/ML-driven GL code assignment, multi-entity coding support, close-acceleration workflow, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
